+
+
+def test_make_date_string_at_each_precision():
+    assert make_date_string(2000, None, None) == '2000'
+    assert make_date_string(2000, 2, None) == '2000-02'
+    assert make_date_string(2000, 2, 9) == '2000-02-09'
+    assert make_date_string(2000, None, 9) == '2000'
+
+
+def test_patron_check_ins_requires_id_and_updatable_content():
+    handler = patron_check_ins()
+    assert handler.is_valid({'id': 1, 'year': 2000})
+    assert handler.is_valid({'id': 1, 'data': {}})
+    assert handler.is_valid({'id': 1, 'year': 2000, 'data': {}})
+    assert not handler.is_valid({'year': 2000})
+    assert not handler.is_valid({'data': {}})
+    assert not handler.is_valid({'id': 1, 'month': 2, 'day': 9})
+    assert not handler.is_valid({'id': None, 'year': 2000})
+    assert not handler.is_valid(None)
+
+
+def test_patron_check_ins_updates_only_own_event(monkeypatch):
+    updates = []
+    request = {'id': 7, 'year': 2000, 'month': 2, 'day': 9, 'data': {'note': 'Read'}}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(checkins.web, 'data', lambda: json.dumps(request).encode())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins, 'get_current_user', lambda: {'key': '/people/reader'}
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'select_all_by_username',
+        lambda username: [{'id': 7}] if username == 'reader' else [],
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'update_event_date',
+        lambda event_id, date: updates.append(('date', event_id, date)),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'update_event_data',
+        lambda event_id, data: updates.append(('data', event_id, data)),
+    )
+    rejected = object()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(checkins.web, 'badrequest', lambda **kwargs: rejected)
+
+    handler = patron_check_ins()
+    handler.POST('reader')
+    assert updates == [
+        ('date', 7, '2000-02-09'),
+        ('data', 7, '{"note": "Read"}'),
+    ]
+
+    updates.clear()
+    assert handler.POST('someone-else') is rejected
+    assert updates == []
+
+
+def test_patron_check_ins_rejects_empty_updates_before_database_access(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.web, 'data', lambda: json.dumps({'id': 7, 'month': 2}).encode()
+    )
+    def unexpected_database_access(username):
+        raise AssertionError('Invalid requests must not query events')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents, 'select_all_by_username', unexpected_database_access
+    )
+    rejected = object()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(checkins.web, 'badrequest', lambda **kwargs: rejected)
+
+    assert patron_check_ins().POST('reader') is rejected
